# openmetadata_role (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata role. A role groups policies that grant access to metadata assets and is assigned to users and teams.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_policy" "data_steward" {
  name        = "DataStewardPolicy"
  description = "Allows data stewards to curate data assets."

  rules = [{
    name       = "curate-assets"
    effect     = "allow"
    operations = ["ViewAll", "EditDescription"]
    resources  = ["table"]
  }]
}

resource "openmetadata_role" "data_steward" {
  name         = "DataSteward"
  display_name = "Data Steward"
  description  = "Curates and documents data assets."
  policies     = [openmetadata_policy.data_steward.fully_qualified_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name. Changing it replaces the role, because the name is also its fully qualified name.
- `policies` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of the policies granted to the role. The server sorts the list, so it is modelled as a set. At least one is required.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the role.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name. For a role this equals name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_role.data_steward 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which for a role is its name.
terraform import openmetadata_role.data_steward DataSteward
```
